citations.note: Wright-Patterson AFB sits at the Mad River terminus, adjacent to the watershed point. The base is the strongest documented federal-enclave signal in the network after Lima.
The installation itself, from the DoD MIRTA site register (`watermark --site wpafb enclave`). Planning-grade and a partial footprint (5,230.4 mapped acres), so it places the base without bounding it.

The 1991 CERCLA §120 Federal Facility Agreement's Findings of Fact (Section 5) state the base covers ~8,200 acres across "Areas A and C" and "Area B" — the figure the MIRTA footprint above falls short of.
